svg.title: VYREALM 1.0.8 architecture
svg.desc: Four-panel architecture: entry and local state, editing flow, optional providers, output and human review. Optional YouTube upload is mock-tested only.

g.text: One studio. One local control plane.
Browser or Windows desktop → the same project library and execution routes
Session token / revision checks / owned job dispatch
From a brief to an editable result.
Bounded edit rules and durable work / technical checks do not approve creative quality
Local automations keep the saved revision and stop at human review.
Optional providers need configuration / the basic footage editor does not need a model
Review words and timing before rendering
Source receipts saved to the project
LATER SOURCE WORK — NOT RELEASED IN 1.0.8
Guided audio installation + the new Original shots workspace are outside this released flow.
Review remains a real step / exporting a file does not publish it
Watch the film. Check words, rights and destination.
Scheduled runs need the app running
¹ Windows DPAPI token protection. ² Optional post-processing, not native detail or frame-rate claims.
